name: CCD Arts Council
install: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @workspace/ccd run build:pitch && pnpm --filter @workspace/ccd run build:facts && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build

terminals.name: api-server
terminals.command: cd artifacts/api-server && NODE_ENV=development PORT=8080 pnpm run start
terminals.description: Express API server (health check + PDF export). The frontend proxies /api requests here.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd artifacts/ccd && PORT=5173 pnpm exec vite --config vite.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0
terminals.description: Creative Curriculum Designer frontend (Vite + React) served on port 5173.
